### moodle-plugin-coding
- Path: C:\Users\orteg\.config\opencode\skills\moodle-plugin-coding\SKILL.md
- Trigger: Creating/modifying Moodle plugin PHP files, db definitions, settings, classes
- Rules:
  - Use long PHP tags only (`<?php`) and never close with `?>` at EOF
  - Keep line length readable (target ~132, avoid >180)
  - Use 4 spaces for indentation (no tabs) and no trailing whitespace
  - Prefer short array syntax (`[]`) in new code
  - Use single quotes for literals; double quotes for interpolation/complex SQL
  - Use lowercase `true`, `false`, `null`
  - For control flow, always use braces; use `else if` (not `elseif`)
  - Keep variable names lowercase, meaningful, positive (`$allowx`, not `$preventx`)
  - Use type hints and return types in all new code where possible
  - Avoid generic `array $options = []` parameters; prefer explicit typed arguments or an options class
